notes: Project: hearth-and-horizon, Little Lamps shelf; piece: aloysius-and-the-man-in-the-street (about 1,350 words, text only: audio 474 MB > 400 MB cap). Little Lamps was the shelf longest without a piece (#16000). Sources checked this run: en.wikipedia and it.wikipedia (citing Cepari), the 1907 Catholic Encyclopedia (newadvent 01331c), en.wikipedia on Bellarmine (cardinal 1599, buried beside Aloysius) and Ferrante Gonzaga (died 13 Feb 1586). Disagreements put in the note: beatification 1605 vs 1621, Borromeo meeting place, first order considered. Adversarial re-read cut: a 'little suit of armour', novice floor-sweeping, a pope-deaths clause; hedged the typhus claim and the 'go on playing' attribution. New next-up proposal: Peter Canisius. No agent doc: nothing new for the next run beyond the bible's proposal and the post.
